profiling_kind: New final-config execution, not relabelled beta=.20 measurements
calibration_reference_authority: Current publication Full Orbit V3, shared with matched Figure8b and Layer3 authority
warmup_policy: 50 batches before each of the two timing modes; no selection or rejection of repeats
repeat_definition: Five separate timed loops in the same process and device, disjoint measurement intervals; technical timing repeats, not independent training runs. No process restart between repeats, matching Table 7.
pool: CIFAR-10 official test indices 0..2047; timing only
step_clock: perf_counter_ns; torch.cuda.synchronize immediately before start and before stop for every stage invocation
e2e_clock: perf_counter; torch.cuda.synchronize immediately before and after each 200-batch repeat; same unmodified Table 7 scorer
summary: mean and sample SD (ddof=1) of five repeat means; unit ms per batch of 64

step_boundaries.view_construction: H2D and original / brightness .90 / reflect padding + 1px crop
step_boundaries.forward: Sum of 3 view forwards, including normalization and Layer3 hook setup/removal; FP32 Softplus head
step_boundaries.gradient_extraction: Sum of 3 formal decision-margin constructions and autograd.grad to Layer3; original-view prediction fixed
step_boundaries.gop_signature: Sum of 3 channelwise gradient-square spatial means and epsilon-normalization
step_boundaries.jsd: Stack 3 signatures and normalized generalized JSD, clamp minimum zero
step_boundaries.risk_mapping: CPU return of prediction, evidence, strength and d_GOP + class-conditional midrank + exp(-.40*q_func) + c_global + explicit alpha and uncertainty; two timed pieces summed

outside_six_steps: Input batch slicing, original class argmax, Python orchestration, tensor lifetime cleanup and final shape/finiteness validation. Extra profiling synchronization changes execution timing.
e2e_inclusions: Slicing, H2D, all 3 views/normalization/forwards/gradients/signatures/JSD, CPU return, risk/calibration, output shape and finite validation; excludes initial disk decode and model/reference load.

figure_contract.claim: Measured step latency of frozen beta=.40 Full Orbit under this runtime; dominant cost is determined from actual repeats.
figure_contract.error_bars: sample SD across 5 repeat means; dots show all 5 repeats
figure_contract.role: efficiency characterization; no causal beta comparison
